responsibility: Contains the RTL machine description for Moxie instruction selection and final assembly emission. It includes the target predicates and constraints files, defines instruction attributes such as length, and specifies the concrete insn patterns, expands, and output templates for arithmetic, logic, shifts, moves, loads/stores, comparisons, branches, calls, jumps, and prologue/epilogue generation, including alternative encodings for immediates and address classes and feature-gated patterns like MUL.X/UMUL.X.
same_name_distinction: Provides the machine description of Moxie instructions, constraints, expands, and asm output templates used for RTL instruction selection and emission; unlike moxie.cc it is not C++ hook code, unlike moxie.h it is not the macro-level architectural configuration, and unlike moxie.opt it is not an option-definition table.
